description: Northern Province Provincial Council - Appropriation Statute No. 04 of 2014. A statute to provide for the Service of the Financial Year 2015
reasoning: This gazette content establishes the "Appropriation Statute No. 04 of 2014" which authorizes financial provisions and expenditure limits for the Northern Province Provincial Council for the 2015 financial year. It creates legal frameworks for budget allocation, fund transfers, expenditure limits, and financial management procedures. This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes as it involves statutory instruments, legal provisions for financial management, and regulatory frameworks for provincial government expenditures.
